properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 18 at 9:49AM CDT until October 20 at 6:00AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...In Alabama, Mobile Coastal and Baldwin Coastal
Counties. In Florida, Escambia Coastal, Santa Rosa Coastal and
Okaloosa Coastal Counties.

* WHEN...Through late Monday night.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
properties.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

NWSheadline: HIGH RIP CURRENT RISK NOW IN EFFECT THROUGH LATE MONDAY NIGHT

properties.description:

highest across the Straits of Florida.

* WHERE...Straits of Florida, Hawk Channel, Gulf waters
including the Dry Tortugas, and Florida Bay.

* WHEN...In Effect.

* IMPACTS...A Small Craft Advisory means that wind speeds of 20
to 33 knots, or seas of 7 feet or greater, are expected to
produce hazardous conditions for small craft. These hazardous
conditions may result in poor vessel handling and steering
response, broaching, overturned dinghies and kayaks, slips and
falls on slippery decks, rub damage along docks and seawalls,
swamped bows at reef tract mooring balls, and dragging anchors.
properties.instruction:
Inexperienced boaters, especially those with smaller vessels,
should avoid operating in these conditions.

properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 18 at 6:35AM AKDT until October 19 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the first Small Craft Advisory, seas 7 to 8 ft. For
the second Small Craft Advisory, south winds 20 to 30 kt with
gusts up to 35 kt and seas 6 to 9 ft expected. For the Gale
Warning, south winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
seas 7 to 11 ft expected.

* WHERE...Cape Spencer to Cape Fairweather from 15 to 85 NM.

* WHEN...For the first Small Craft Advisory, until 1 PM AKDT
this afternoon. For the second Small Craft Advisory, from 1 PM
to 7 PM AKDT Monday. For the Gale Warning, from 7 PM to 10 PM
AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
